summary: The agent implements a structured machine learning pipeline with appropriate data cleaning, feature engineering, and a proper train/validation split. However, it suffers from a critical target leakage issue by applying target encoding without out-of-fold calculation, which will cause the LightGBM model to severely overfit. Additionally, the agent relies on a single evaluation of a stochastic model and only computes one evaluation metric.
